observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with a DualShock 4 controller on top, placed on a black surface. The console has a blue light on the front, and the controller has a blue glow. A TV screen is visible to the left, showing a blue screen.

Photo 1 shows the same console and controller, but now placed in front of a Sony PS4 box. The box is blue and white, with 'PS4' and '500+ GB' visible. The console and controller appear to be the same as in photo 0.
The console has a glossy finish with visible scratches and scuffs, especially on the top surface.
The controller has a standard layout with analog sticks, touchpad, and buttons, and appears to be a standard DualShock 4 model.
No games, cables, or power supply are visible in either photo.
The seller claims 'Hack ps4 with Fc26 and 7 games pad' — this suggests the console is hacked, has 7 games, and a controller (pad).
